why_trace.root_cause: Session recovery had no portable content identity, so a saved work card could not distinguish a matching transcript from a changed or unavailable source.
evidence: Synthetic fixture tests cover snapshot round trips, source drift, snapshot tamper, and unavailable inventory states.
Fresh wheel consumer proof creates a new recovery artifact and verifies a matching Claude source.
The snapshot stores event digests and bounded card claims without copying transcript text.
Synthetic fixture tests cover redacted trace export/import, deterministic output, tamper refusal, and partial-input refusal.
Trace rows are canonical JSONL with source identity, redacted event, and envelope digests; the native store is not needed for import.
